events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Known for his distinctive vocals and outspoken personality, Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Tune
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! What's your ultimate Liam Gallagher track, whether it's an Oasis anthem or a solo belter? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single re-released in the UK (1975)
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was re-released as a single in the UK, reaching number six on the charts.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 'Imagine' a world... John Lennon's timeless message still resonates decades later. What line from this iconic track stays with you?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, a portable music player that revolutionised how people listened to music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Before streaming, there was the iPod. Remember getting your first one? What was the first album you loaded onto it?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962, launching one of cinema's most enduring franchises.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! What's your all-time favourite Bond film, gadget, or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The iconic Beatles co-founder and solo artist left an indelible mark on music and culture.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring genius of John Lennon. What's the one song of his that truly speaks to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The inimitable John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the comedic legend John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite John Cleese moment that still makes you laugh?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', a sprawling and experimental masterpiece.

angles.name: White Album Deep Cuts
angles.copy: The 'White Album' is 58 today! With 30 tracks, it's packed with classics and deep cuts. Which underrated gem do you always go back to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45. The Queen frontman would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Long Live Freddie
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the life and legacy of Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today! This album saw The Beatles evolve their sound. What's your standout track from this pivotal record?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically taken from us on this day in 1980 at the age of 40. The peace activist and musical visionary would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we reflect on the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.
